headline: Q2 earnings done for HDFC Bank, ICICI, other private lenders. What's next?
summary: Private banks delivered mixed Q2 FY27 earnings, prompting analysts to identify lenders with attractive valuations and flag those investors may want to avoid. HDFC Bank reported a 5% YoY rise in net profit to Rs 19,510 crore, largely in line with expectations, but its shares have fallen 6% since the results.

headline: A banking giant, a battered stock: Can HDFC Bank’s new chief turn the tide?
summary: HDFC Bank’s stock is down nearly 29% from its peak, and new CEO Anup Bagchi faces a tough turnaround test. Can he revive growth, improve margins and unlock the value of the HDFC merger? We break down the challenges, growth outlook and what investors should watch next.Follow ET Markets for more market insights.

headline: A turbulent year at HDFC Bank: Controversies that kept India’s biggest private lender in the headlines
summary: HDFC Bank has faced a turbulent year marked by governance concerns, its former chairmans abrupt exit, scrutiny of Dubai operations, post-merger profitability challenges and CEO Sashidhar Jagdishans departure. A fresh probe into alleged leaks of confidential information adds to the challenges awaiting incoming chief executive Anup Bagchi as the bank seeks to restore investor confidence.

headline: HDFC Bank begins probe into alleged internal data leak
summary: HDFC Bank is currently investigating potential leaks of confidential information to social media and other outsiders. This internal review aims to assess compliance with the bank

headline: HDFC Bank investigates two senior executives over alleged leak of business secrets
summary: HDFC Bank conducted an internal investigation after concerns about confidential information being leaked surfaced among executives. The probe discovered that two senior executives disclosed sensitive business strategies to outsiders, prompting further examination. This investigation is ongoing, and the involved executives have already been informed of the findings. The bank is committed to upholding ethical standards and will take appropriate action based on the investigation

headline: Banks also count cost of insurance payout curbs
summary: Central Bank of India anticipates a 33% decline in bancassurance fees due to proposed regulations. Canara Bank expects a ₹145-crore hit to its fee income from similar changes. Axis Bank aims to mitigate losses through increased sales volumes and alternative income sources. HDFC Bank has not yet assessed the potential impact of the new rules.

headline: Anup Bagchi backs 'exceptional' team as he connects the dots at HDFC Bank
summary: Anup Bagchi is set to take charge as MD and CEO of HDFC Bank starting October 27. He is currently familiarizing himself with the bank

headline: Three challenges facing HDFC Bank’s new CEO
summary: HDFC Bank's new CEO Anup Bagchi faces the challenge of rebuilding confidence, preventing further senior management departures and reviving the growth engines.

headline: Anup Bagchi takes charge as HDFC Bank CEO and MD, succeeds Jagdishan
summary: His predecessor, Sashidhar Jagdishan, vacated office on Monday after the completion of his term, the bank informed exchanges

headline: HDFC Bank probe reveals data leak by two senior executives – report
summary: The bank’s investigation began after concerns emerged among senior leaders that internal information could have been disclosed.
